newsitem.title: POLAND: Importers weaken zloty vs basket, T/N depos rise.
newsitem.headline: Importers weaken zloty vs basket, T/N depos rise.

text.p: The Polish zloty weakened against the basket of currencies on importers currency-buying and banks lengthening currency positions to protect thenselves against potential future central bank interventions, dealers said.

They said that zloty eased also because the dollar rose on world markets. The domestic currency-buying was strong enough to offset the reported small-scale foreign currency sales for T-bonds payments on March 5, 1997.
"The zloty eased on client orders... and banks lenghtening currency positions to protect themselves in case of an NBP intervention," said Piotr Czyzewski of ING Bank in Warsaw.
Analysts said zloty may continue to inch down against basket tomorrow driven by small client orders with a near-term upswing not likely unless foreigners again buy Polish paper.

One-day deposit rates, pulled down by excess funds on average reserve accounts before February's period end on Thursday, slipped as low as 10 percent in overnight cash, but a central bank drainage kept tomorrow/next rates underpinned.
On Wednesday the central bank drained 910 million zlotys for seven and 14 days and sold 400 million of its 91-day bills.
